protection against discrimination or violence.","contrary_evidence":["Consensual same-sex activity was not explicitly criminalized, but morality, prostitution and cybercrime provisions produced de facto criminalization."],"evidence_id":"E013","excerpt":"State targeting and ineffective protection of LGBT people were arbitrary detention and impunity intact.","contrary_evidence":["The strategy proposed reviewing death-eligible crimes, alternatives to pretrial detention and comprehensive violence-against-women legislation; the dialogue and pardons created some limited openings."],"evidence_id":"E014","excerpt":"Reform initiatives did not displace documented repression or impunity.","final_evidence_use":"final_evidence","period_fit":"target-period implementation of 2021 strategy","publication_date":"2022-09-21","publisher":"Amnesty launched","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2022/09/egypt-human-rights-crisis-deepens-one-year-after-national-human-rights-strategy-launched/"},{"canonical_fact_key":"egypt-2022-sisi-people-of-evil-rhetoric","claim":"Sisi said he had referred to the Muslim Brotherhood for seven years as the 'people of evil,' while claiming that authorities had avoided tyranny and had given the group an opportunity to retreat.","contrary_evidence":["In the same account Sisi said he sought to avoid clashes and tyranny and prayed for the good of all Egyptians; no explicit exhortation to private violence was located."],"evidence_id":"E015","excerpt":"Direct hostile labeling was recorded, without an explicit instruction to violence.","final_evidence_use":"final_evidence","period_fit":"target-period statement referring to longer-running rhetoric","publication_date":"2022-05-02","publisher":"Egypt State Information Service","ruler_attribution":"direct","source_confidence":"medium","source_confidence_reason":"Official source, but direct retrieval was blocked and indexed text was inspected.","source_locator":"indexed article text; direct page returned 502 during inspection","source_type":"official_speech_report","title":"Sisi: Army had received three direct threats from the Brotherhood group","url":"https://sis.gov.eg/en/media-center/news/sisi-army-had-received-three-direct-threats-from-the-brotherhood-group/"},{"canonical_fact_key":"sisi_2022_brotherhood_people_of_evil_speech","claim":"In a May 2, 2022 intervention at an Eid celebration, Sisi said Muslim Brotherhood leaders had threatened to burn the country, conduct popular trials, kill, and bring fighters from elsewhere; he said he had avoided naming the Brotherhood for seven years and instead called it the 'people of evil' to give it an opportunity to retreat from evil. This is direct presidential scapegoating and threat-framing, but the located text contains no instruction to the public to attack Brotherhood members.","contrary_evidence":["The same passage presents the label as restraint intended to allow retreat and does not expressly advocate violence against the group."],"evidence_id":"E016","excerpt":"The exact May speech is direct hostile labeling, not an explicit call to attack.","final_evidence_use":"final_evidence","period_fit":"Exact: 2 May 2022","publication_date":"2022-05-02","publisher":"Egypt State Information Service","ruler_attribution":"Direct words of Abdel Fattah el-Sisi.","source_confidence":"high","source_confidence_reason":"Contemporaneous official publication, though direct retrieval was intermittent.","source_locator":"Article dated 2 May 2022; paragraphs beginning 'The president said that the army had received three direct threats' and 'For seven years I did not mention them'; official page is now indexed but intermittently returns 502","source_type":"primary presidential speech record","title":"Sisi: Army had received three direct threats from the Brotherhood group","url":"https://sis.gov.eg/en/media-center/news/sisi-army-had-received-three-direct-threats-from-the-brotherhood-group/"},{"canonical_fact_key":"sisi_2022_brotherhood_people_of_evil_speech_context","claim":"Contemporaneous Arabic reporting reproduces Sisi's extended wording: alleged threats to burn the country, conduct popular trials, kill, and bring fighters, followed by his statement that for seven years he used 'people of evil' instead of naming the Brotherhood. The complete passage supports classification as collective hostile labeling and alleged-threat narration, not an explicit call for listeners to commit violence.","contrary_evidence":["The report supplies no evidence that the remarks produced violence and quotes Sisi describing his euphemism as an opportunity for the group to desist."],"evidence_id":"E017","excerpt":"Arabic contemporaneous reporting corroborates the extended speech wording and its limit.","final_evidence_use":"final_evidence","period_fit":"Exact: 2 May 2022","publication_date":"2022-05-02","publisher":"El Watan","ruler_attribution":"Direct quotation attributed to Sisi at a public event.","source_confidence":"medium-high","source_confidence_reason":"Named contemporaneous outlet reproducing lengthy speech text; not sufficient to establish underlying historical allegations.","source_locator":"Lines 83-93, especially quoted speech at lines 86-92","source_type":"independent Arabic contemporaneous reporting","title":"Sisi reveals three times the Brotherhood threatened to burn Egypt","url":"https://www.elwatannews.com/news/details/6069571"},{"canonical_fact_key":"sinai_2022_three_custodial_executions","claim":"The Foundation located and analyzed videos appearing from early July through mid-August 2022 showing three separate close-range killings of unarmed, wounded, or restrained men, apparently by pro-military tribal fighters. The material appeared on accounts officially representing or operated by army-aligned groups. This materially resolves the events as most likely occurring during 2022 operations, while remaining an evidentiary assessment rather than a judicial finding.","contrary_evidence":["The source repeatedly uses probabilistic language about perpetrators and dates and does not establish a presidential command chain for the executions."],"evidence_id":"E018","excerpt":"Local video analysis strengthens the 2022 timing of apparent aligned-force executions.","final_evidence_use":"final_evidence","period_fit":"Strong: videos appeared July-August 2022 and were assessed as most likely depicting current 2022 hostilities.","publication_date":"2022-08-20","publisher":"Sinai Foundation for Human Rights","ruler_attribution":"Authority-based national responsibility only; no evidence Sisi ordered, knew of, or approved individual killings.","source_confidence":"medium-high","source_confidence_reason":"Case-specific visual and account-provenance analysis; actor identity and dates remain probabilistic.","source_locator":"Paragraphs 1-3 and video-specific sections; opened-page lines 52-60 and 81","source_type":"local human-rights video investigation","title":"Again: Videos show extrajudicial executions in Sinai by the military and its collaborators","url":"https://sinaifhr.org/show/148"},{"canonical_fact_key":"egypt_decree_13_2022_police_day_pardon","claim":"Sisi issued Decree No. 13/2022 granting remission of remaining custodial sentences to defined classes of prisoners effective January 25, generally including eligible prisoners who had completed one-third of their terms. The published decree proves direct presidential ownership of the pardon mechanism but does not name the 13 police personnel later reported as beneficiaries.","contrary_evidence":["The public text is class-based and contains no beneficiary names, so it cannot alone prove that particular convicted officers were pardoned."],"evidence_id":"E019","excerpt":"The January decree establishes direct presidential ownership of a class-based pardon mechanism.","final_evidence_use":"final_evidence","period_fit":"Exact: January 2022 decree and eligibility date","publication_date":"2022-01-23","publisher":"Official Gazette of Egypt via Manshurat Legal","ruler_attribution":"Direct: presidential decree issued by Sisi.","source_confidence":"high","source_confidence_reason":"Official Gazette text reproduced by a specialist legal repository.","source_locator":"Decree heading and Article 1; second eligibility category reproduced at opened-page line 100","source_type":"primary presidential decree","title":"Republican Decree No. 13 of 2022 concerning pardons for Police Day and the January 25 Revolution","url":"https://manshurat.org/node/75155"},{"canonical_fact_key":"egypt_2022_pardon_convicted_police_officers_names","claim":"Arabi21 reported, based on a displayed official-looking document and an unnamed senior security source, that 13 officers and policemen convicted in three torture-to-death cases were released under Sisi's Police Day pardon. It identifies one matter as Case 8414/2018, Hadaiq al-Qubba felonies, concerning Ahmed al-Sayed Mohamed Agami. This upgrades the allegation with a case number but remains leaked-document reporting, not a published beneficiary annex.","contrary_evidence":["The official public decree contains no names, leaving the decisive beneficiary link dependent on a leak and anonymous sourcing."],"evidence_id":"E020","excerpt":"A leaked-document report supplies names and a case number but not definitive official verification.","final_evidence_use":"final_evidence","period_fit":"Exact: reported April 2022 concerning the January 2022 pardon","publication_date":"2022-04-27","publisher":"Arabi21","ruler_attribution":"Direct if the beneficiary document is authentic, because it links named officers to Sisi's Decree 13/2022.","source_confidence":"medium","source_confidence_reason":"Document image and case detail are provided, but the source is anonymous and no Gazette annex was recovered.","source_locator":"Paragraphs 1-3 and case sections; opened-page lines 58-64 and 85; embedded document image linked after paragraph naming Case 8414/2018","source_type":"investigative Arabic reporting based on leaked document","title":"Presidential pardon for Egyptian officers implicated in torture cases (document)","url":"https://arabi21.com/story/1434502/%D8%B9%D9%81%D9%88-%D8%B1%D8%A6%D8%A7%D8%B3%D9%8A-%D8%B9%D9%86-%D8%B6%D8%A8%D8%A7%D8%B7-%D8%A8%D9%85%D8%B5%D8%B1-%D9%85%D8%AA%D9%88%D8%B1%D8%B7%D9%8A%D9%86-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D9%82%D8%B6%D8%A7%D9%8A%D8%A7-%D8%AA%D8%B9%D8%B0%D9%8A%D8%A8-%D9%88%D8%AB%D9%8A%D9%82%D8%A9"},{"canonical_fact_key":"hadhoud_2022_prosecution_closure_and_appeal","claim":"On June 23, 2022, New Cairo Criminal Court Circuit 28 upheld the Nasr City Prosecution's no-prosecution decision in Case 738/2022 concerning Ayman Hadhoud's custodial death and rejected the family's civil claim.
